boss_intro: Ah. The dinosaur. I calculated you would arrive four minutes ago. Tardy.
Welcome to my workshop. Do mind the turrets — they mind you.
I am the Method, little reptile. Every swing measured, every step planned. Do try to keep up.
taunt_mid: Sloppy footwork. I shall deduct marks.
You attack the shield? The SHIELD? Consult the manual, dear.
Every move you make is going in my notebook. Under 'needs improvement'.
Precision, dinosaur. Flailing is not a strategy.
My gears solved you three moves ago.
hit_react: Noted. That will not work twice. …Probably.
Adequate strike. Do not let it go to your head.
low_hp: My calculations are… fraying at the edges…
Systems wobbling. This was NOT in the blueprints.
You are… persistently educational, aren't you.
defeat_freed: The cog releases… oh. OH. My mind is my OWN again. How… wonderful. Thank you.
Fascinating. You defeated the Method with understanding. I must… take notes.
Freed! And by a student, no less. There is hope for this world after all.
I concede — graciously, precisely, and with immense relief. Well solved, young rex.
ask_intro: A ratio problem, dinosaur. Do impress me.
Gears never lie. Let us see if you understand them.
Question! Answer as if your marks depend on it. They do not. But answer well.
correct_first_try: Correct. Full marks. Do not gloat — it's unbecoming and I'm already doing it for you.
Precisely right. I may frame this moment.
Correct! There — the sound of a mind meshing perfectly.
correct_after_hint: Correct — with assistance. Engineering IS teamwork, I suppose.
There we are. A second attempt that lands is worth two firsts that don't.
Right answer. The hint merely oiled the gears — YOU turned them.
incorrect_gentle: Not quite. Breathe. Even my best turret misfired on its first day. Hint?
Incorrect — but tidily so. Shall I lend you a clue?
Mm, no. But your reasoning had promising bolts in it. A hint, perhaps?
teach: Observe the mechanism, step by step. THIS is how it turns.
Class is in session. Watch closely — then it is your turn again.
cafe_farewell: Do return. My gears — and my quizzes — are always calibrated for you.
Dismissed! Top marks for attendance, dinosaur.
